entries.title: Pony Island

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Pony Island is sourced as a Windows, Mac, and Linux PC release; Windows PC is the preferred capture/input route for the desktop metafiction puzzle interface.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Pony Island on Steam for Windows PC and play the current desktop release.

entries.remaster_caveats: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus is announced/TBA and is not yet a released playable archive entry.
